paper_metadata.title: Cryoforged nanotwinned CoCrNi medium-entropy alloy with exceptional fatigue property at cryogenic temperature

evidence.quote: The extraordinary work hardening ability and fracture toughness of the face-centered cubic medium-entropy alloy (MEA) at cryogenic temperature make them good candidates for harsh applications.

attributes.morphology: microscale twin skeleton in two primary directions

evidence.quote: Fig. 1 c presents a band contrast image coupled with the twin boundary (TB), which shows a microscale twin skeleton feature in two primary directions, giving birth to a twin-twin network.

attributes.size: average NT thickness ~38.3 nm; average NT spacing ~405.4 nm
attributes.morphology: network of high-density nanoscale twins and microbands

evidence.quote: TEM micrographs in Figs. 1 e and f reveal a more intricate network structure comprised of high-density nanoscale twins and microbands within MDCF-MEA. The average NT thickness (~38.3 nm) and spacing (~405.4 nm) are summarized in Fig. 1 g.
In contrast to the single-direction NT structure with a spacing of 878.4 nm in CR-MEA, a denser twin-twin network is generated in MDCF-MEA due to the multidirectional process.
